factions.name: Umbral Vanguard
factions.description: Elite defenders tied to the Umbral Plains, tasked with containing resonance storms and preventing planar collapse.
goals: maintain control of the Borderlands and Depths breach points

factions.name: Shadowed Akheva
factions.description: A splinter Akhevan sect performing shadow-ritual experiments on resonance and holy energy.
goals: establish ritual vaults in the Depths and Caverns

factions.name: Vampyric Courts of Tenebrous
factions.description: Ancient vampyre nobility ruling throne chambers and blood-ritual sanctums in the Depths and surrounding tunnels.
goals: feed on resonance and mortal blood

factions.name: Razorfiend Broods
factions.description: Territorial apex predators whose resonance-mutated broods dominate cliffs, hollows, and lower territories.
goals: adapt to resonance storms for greater power

factions.name: Lightcrawler Swarms
factions.description: Bioluminescent nocturnal hunters tied to holy resonance caverns and ridge winds.
goals: maintain brood dominance in Ridge and Pits
respond to holy resonance flares and mutations
